The reboot, titled Black Bullet: New World Order, will be a revised and expanded version of the original light novel. The story will cover the events of the first six original volumes through the New World Order's fourth volume, before continuing into a completely new arc in the fifth volume, which will be a fully rewritten version...

Katayama began drawing the dystopian sci-fi suspense manga in Bessatsu Shounen Magazine in March 2021.
